title: A clip's sound is on the timeline from the moment it opens
goal: A recording's own sound is invisible until Detach Sound; a dropped sound shows as a flat blue bar with no waveform. The user: 'no audio segments'. Target: the user's mocks (docs/design/mocks/pages/video.html, video-shell.html, comp-video.html and the page named here) at their fidelity; runner-prompt rules on default config, side-by-side with the mock, labels-not-explanations and right-click apply. Ask throughout: would a Premiere editor get this, and is it easier here?
notes: Filed from the 2026-09-23 video audit in the intake window.
acceptance: Every clip with sound shows a linked audio segment with a waveform on an audio track under it, from open
Right-click, Detach Audio unlinks it so it moves on its own; linked clips move together
Trim, fade handles on the segment corners, volume by dragging the level line, music on its own track
The mix meter moves into the transport area as the mock places volume
